stories.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home in criminal investigation
new_facts: Federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's home Monday, weeks before midterms; House Democrats call it abuse of power.
DOJ says it approved the warrant and calls the search part of an ongoing federal investigation.
The agents who conducted the search are identified as immigration agents.
Search falls inside the 60-day pre-election window, when DOJ has historically avoided such steps against candidates.
Investigation reportedly centers on Omar's immigration documents, paperwork filled out by her late father when she was a child.
Trump and allies have accused Omar of immigration fraud and called for her expulsion; Omar says the raid weaponizes law enforcement.
Katie Miller posted then deleted "Promise made, promise kept" in reply to a NY Post article on the raid.
stories.line: Federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's Washington home under a warrant the DOJ says it approved, as part of a criminal investigation.

stories.title: Pope Leo to have lung nodule surgery at hospital Tuesday
new_facts: Pope Leo XIV disclosed a lung nodule at Sunday prayer and will have it surgically removed, hospital Tuesday.
Vatican confirmed on Monday that Leo will be admitted to a Rome hospital Tuesday morning; quotes his statement.
Described as the first major health event of Leo's 17-month pontificate.
Leo called the death penalty 'inadmissible' as the Pentagon plans a livestreamed execution later this year.
stories.line: Pope Leo will enter hospital Tuesday for planned lung nodule surgery, the Vatican says, and his work continues.

stories.title: Meta debuts Muse Wonder AI model, starting with paying subscribers
new_facts: Muse Wonder includes new features meant to keep AI agents from going off the rails
Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, claiming state-of-the-art agentic performance after a 14-month AI overhaul
Models are positioned to compete with rivals Anthropic and OpenAI
Zuckerberg says on record Meta has reached the AI frontier and rejects calls for a slowdown
Muse Wonder follows Muse Spark, first model from Meta's Superintelligence Labs, and the Muse agent
stories.line: Meta is launching its Muse Wonder AI model, starting with paying subscribers, as it competes with rivals at the AI frontier.

stories.title: Fire destroys Marché des Enfants Rouges, Paris's oldest covered food market
stories.line: A fire has destroyed the Marché des Enfants Rouges, Paris's oldest covered food market, a longtime local and tourist destination.

stories.title: Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport kill 16, prompt flight suspensions and FAA warning
new_facts: Viral videos purporting to show the Riyadh airport attack were found to be AI-generated.
FAA warned US airlines of flight risks over Saudi Arabia; Delta weighing Oct. 23 launch.
Saudi extended Riyadh airport closure; Saturday Houthi attack left 13 dead, 300+ injured; coalition responding.
At least 20 killed in a week of attacks on Saudi airports, per aviation authority account.
Delta postponed its planned Oct. 23 first US-Saudi nonstop service until March.
Iran, patron of the Houthis, offered to mediate; Saudi authorities say they are fending off further attacks.
All Riyadh flights suspended until next Saturday after new attack killed one; energy minister: 'fear has no place'.
Attacks described as deadliest assault on Saudi soil in over a decade.
Saudi minister vowed a 'serious response'; Riyadh airport and another facility were hit.
stories.line: Houthi attacks on Riyadh's airport have killed at least 16 and disrupted Saudi flights, with carriers and the FAA issuing warnings.

stories.title: Musk has given over $276 million to Republican midterm efforts
new_facts: Musk has given at least $276M to Republicans for the midterms, making him the biggest known midterm donor.
Musk's total 2026 midterm spending is about $366M, with $276M since July; Democrats' chances have improved.
$158M of Musk's donations went into Senate efforts, one of the largest political donations in US history.
Trump reportedly in a "foul mood" on a midterm rally tour of smaller venues in deep red areas.
Musk's roughly $290M backing Trump's 2024 election is the benchmark; the $366M midterm spending is about $76M more.
stories.line: Elon Musk has poured over $276 million into Republican midterm efforts, reportedly to help the party keep Congress.

stories.title: Zelenskyy says Russia hit six Ukrainian energy sites since Trump's energy ceasefire
new_facts: Zelensky says Russia has hit six Ukrainian energy sites since Trump announced an energy infrastructure ceasefire.
Zelenskyy vows to retaliate if grid strikes continue; says he was surprised by the announcement; Trump feud over refinery strikes.
Axios, citing an unnamed US source, says the ceasefire covers only oil refineries; Zelensky learned of it via media.
Russian strikes hit Kharkiv within 24 hours; Kremlin says it would only consider a one-day ceasefire for an election.
stories.line: Zelenskyy says Russia kept hitting Ukrainian energy sites after Trump announced an energy ceasefire, testing the pause.

stories.title: Pupil, 14, arrested after shooting two teachers at French middle school
new_facts: A 14-year-old pupil was arrested after a middle-school principal and a teacher were shot and injured at a French school.
A staff member disarmed the suspect, who hid a hunting shotgun in a guitar case, before police arrived.
Alleged motive: the boy was dumped by his girlfriend; the shooting happened Monday in southern France.
stories.line: A 14-year-old allegedly shot two teachers at a French middle school in Aubagne; both were injured, not fatally.

stories.title: Burnham vows to renegotiate Brexit trade deal at November EU summit
new_facts: Burnham, as Greater Manchester mayor, formally met Man City chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak at an October 2021 investment summit.
Burnham told the Commons he will meet Ursula von der Leyen in Brussels on November 20, calling Brexit 'not good enough'.
Burnham says the British public will be 'the boss' of the EU reset and vows to renegotiate the trade deal.
stories.line: The UK prime minister says he will seek to renegotiate post-Brexit trade terms with the EU at a summit next month.

stories.title: Thousands march in Delhi demanding India's election chief resign over voter list purge
new_facts: First item of a new story: Indian opposition parties marched in New Delhi against a voter list purge they say favours Modi's party.
Protesters march to the Supreme Court demanding the chief election commissioner resign, after a newspaper investigation found concerns raised inside the body.
Authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll.
The 'cockroach' youth movement and the opposition leader joined the Monday march to the Supreme Court.
stories.line: Opposition parties and protesters are marching in New Delhi against a voter-roll revision that critics say removed over 133 million names and favors the ruling BJP.
